arxiv-2106-11648.title: On the effective reduction of an ideal
arxiv-2106-11648.creator: Tomasz Rodak, Adam Różycki, Stanisław Spodzieja
arxiv-2106-11648.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tomasz Rodak, Adam Różycki, Stanisław Spodzieja. It is well known that in the Noetherian local ring with infinite residue field the reduction of 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} -primary ideal may be given in the form of a sufficiently general linear combination of its generators. In the paper we give a condition for the existence of such reduction in terms of the sum of degrees of the ideal fiber cone prime divisors in the case of any Noetherian local ring.

arxiv-2110-02270.title: Transformer Assisted Convolutional Network for Cell Instance Segmentation
arxiv-2110-02270.creator: Deepanshu Pandey, Pradyumna Gupta *, Sumit Bhattacharya *, Aman Sinha, Rohit Agarwal
arxiv-2110-02270.description: Abstract Region proposal based methods like R-CNN and Faster R-CNN models have proven to be extremely successful in object detection and segmentation tasks. Recently, Transformers have also gained popularity in the domain of Computer Vision, and are being utilised to improve the performance of conventional models.

arxiv-2312-08827.title: Artificial Intelligence and Human Geography Chapter in the Encyclopedia of Human Geography
arxiv-2312-08827.creator: Song Gao
arxiv-2312-08827.description: Abstract This paper examines the recent advances and applications of AI in human geography especially the use of machine (deep) learning, including place representation and modeling, spatial analysis and predictive mapping, and urban planning and design. AI technologies have enabled deeper insights into complex human-environment interactions, contributing to more effective scientific exploration, understanding of social dynamics, and spatial decision-making.

arxiv-2404-02755.title: DIBS: Enhancing Dense Video Captioning with Unlabeled Videos via Pseudo Boundary Enrichment and Online Refinement

arxiv-2404-02755.description: Abstract We present D ive I nto the B oundarie S ( DIBS ), a novel pretraining framework for dense video captioning (DVC), that elaborates on improving the quality of the generated event captions and their associated pseudo event boundaries from unlabeled videos.

arxiv-2503-12622.title: Real-Time Cell Sorting with Scalable In Situ FPGA-Accelerated Deep Learning

arxiv-2503-12622.description: Abstract Precise cell classification is essential in biomedical diagnostics and therapeutic monitoring, particularly for identifying diverse cell types involved in various diseases. arxiv-2508-20336.title: Adaptive Segmentation of EEG for Machine Learning Applications
arxiv-2508-20336.creator: Johnson Zhou, Joseph West, Krista A. Ehinger, Zhenming Ren, Sam E. John, David B. Grayden
arxiv-2508-20336.description: Abstract Objective. Electroencephalography (EEG) data is derived by sampling continuous neurological time series signals. In order to prepare EEG signals for machine learning, the signal must be divided into manageable segments. The current naive approach uses arbitrary fixed time slices, which may have limited biological relevance because brain states are not confined to fixed intervals.

arxiv-2511-23182.title: Primordial Black Holes as Dark Matter and the Tachyonic Trap During Inflation
arxiv-2511-23182.creator: Yuma S. Furuta, Mindaugas Karčiauskas, Kazunori Kohri, Alejandro Sáez
arxiv-2511-23182.description: Abstract We show that resonant processes during multi-field inflation can generate a large curvature perturbation on small scales. This perturbation naturally leads to the formation of primordial black holes that may constitute dark matter, as well as to the production of stochastic induced gravitational waves in the deci-Hz band.

pmc-10556999.creator: Hui-Xiao Guo, Qi Wang, Can Wang, Qing Chen Yin, Hua Zhi Huo, Bing Hua Yin, Amaryllis Mavragani, Travis Sanchez, Zheng Su, Jiaqian Luo, Maomao Cao

pmc-10672578.title: Neurogenic Bowel Dysfunction in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury and Multiple Sclerosis—An Updated and Simplified Treatment Algorithm
pmc-10672578.creator: Fredrika S Magnuson, Peter Christensen, Andrei Krassioukov, Gianna Rodriguez, Anton Emmanuel, Steven Kirshblum, Klaus Krogh, Jun Kato
pmc-10672578.description: Neurogenic bowel dysfunction (NBD) is a common condition in individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI) or multiple sclerosis (MS). It usually entails constipation, difficult evacuation of the rectum, and fecal incontinence (FI); often in combination. It is highly burdensome for affected patients and is correlated with poor quality of life.

pmc-10748648.title: MIBA Osteotomy vs Open Technique in Hallux Valgus Surgery: Results of a Randomized Prospective Study
pmc-10748648.creator: Mario I. Escudero, Francisco Escobar, Felipe Chaparro, Carlos Albarran, Andrés I. Medina Payá, Manuel J. Pellegrini
pmc-10748648.description: Category:Midfoot/Forefoot; BunionIntroduction/Purpose:In Hallux Valgus (HV) surgery, the open technique has traditionally been used, which implies aggressive and extensive approaches, not without complications. The goal of surgical treatment of HV is to correct the anatomical deformity and achieve a satisfactory long-term result, without interrupting the biomechanics and weight-bearing function of the first metatarsophalangeal joint complex.

pmc-11348609.description: BackgroundWidespread neuropathic pain usually affects a wide range of body areas and inflicts huge suffering on patients. pmc-13197883.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026).
